chapterInfo.content:
12
Yakob nhwɛsoɔ
1 # Hos 7.11 Efraim hwe mframa,
na ɔdi apueeɛ ahum akyi; daa nyinaa
wɔma atorɔ ne ɔsɛeɛ dɔɔso,
na wɔne Asiria kɔ apam,
na wɔsoa ngo kɔ Misraim.
2Na AWURADE ne Yuda anya asɛm,
na ɔreba abɛtwe Yakob aso sɛdeɛ n’akwan teɛ;
sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ no na ɔbɛtua no ka.
3 # Gye 25.22, 26; 32.24-28 Ɔyafunum na ɔsɔɔ ne nua nantin,
na n’ahoɔden mu na ɔne Onyankopɔn koeɛ.
4 # Gye 35.15 Ɔne ɔbɔfoɔ no koe, na ɔtumii;
ɔsui na ɔpaa no kyɛw;
ɔhunuu no Betel,
na ɛhɔ na ɔne yɛn kasaeɛ.
5 # Dwom 83.18 Na AWURADE yɛ asafo Nyankopɔn,
AWURADE ne ne din a wɔde kae no.
6Na wo nso, sane kɔ wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn;
sɔ adɔeɛ ne atemmuo mu,
na hwɛ wo Nyankopɔn kwan daa daa.
7Kanaan, nsisie nsania wɔ ne nsam,
ɔpɛ amimdie.
8 # Adi 3.17 Na Efraim ka sɛ: Manya me ho ara,
manya adeɛ pii mafa; me brɛ nyinaa mu,
wɔannya amumuyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ bɔne amma me.
9 # Hos 13.4 Nso mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn
de firi Misraim asase so;
mɛma woatena ntomadan mu bio
sɛ afahyɛ nna no mu.
10Na makasa makyerɛ adiyifoɔ no,
na mama anisoadehunu adɔɔso,
na menam adiyifoɔ ano so mabubu mmɛ.
11Gilead yɛ abusudeɛ anaa?
Wɔadane ahuhudeɛ ara;
Gilgal hɔ na wɔde anantwie bɔ afɔdeɛ,
wɔn afɔrebukyia no nso te sɛ
afuo mu nkofie so aboɔkuo.
12 # Gye 28.5; 29.20 (Na Yakob dwane kɔɔ Siria asase so,
na Israel som ɛyerɛ ho,
na ɛyerɛ nti ɔhwɛɛ nnwan.)
13 # Eks 3.10 Na AWURADE nam odiyifoɔ so yii Israel firii Misraim bae,
na ɔnam odiyifoɔ so hwɛɛ wɔn.
14Efraim yii abufuo sɛ,
enti ɔbɛma mogya a ɔdi ho so no abua n’atifi,
na n’ahohora nso, n’AWURADE bɛdane agu ne so.

Efraim hwe mframa,
na ɔdi apueeɛ ahum akyi; daa nyinaa
wɔma atorɔ ne ɔsɛeɛ dɔɔso,
na wɔne Asiria kɔ apam,
na wɔsoa ngo kɔ Misraim.
Na AWURADE ne Yuda anya asɛm,
na ɔreba abɛtwe Yakob aso sɛdeɛ n’akwan teɛ;
sɛdeɛ ne nneyɛɛ teɛ no na ɔbɛtua no ka.
Ɔyafunum na ɔsɔɔ ne nua nantin,
na n’ahoɔden mu na ɔne Onyankopɔn koeɛ.
Ɔne ɔbɔfoɔ no koe, na ɔtumii;
ɔsui na ɔpaa no kyɛw;
ɔhunuu no Betel,
na ɛhɔ na ɔne yɛn kasaeɛ.
Na AWURADE yɛ asafo Nyankopɔn,
AWURADE ne ne din a wɔde kae no.
Na wo nso, sane kɔ wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn;
sɔ adɔeɛ ne atemmuo mu,
na hwɛ wo Nyankopɔn kwan daa daa.
Kanaan, nsisie nsania wɔ ne nsam,
ɔpɛ amimdie.
Na Efraim ka sɛ: Manya me ho ara,
manya adeɛ pii mafa; me brɛ nyinaa mu,
wɔannya amumuyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ bɔne amma me.
Nso mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn
de firi Misraim asase so;
mɛma woatena ntomadan mu bio
sɛ afahyɛ nna no mu.
Na makasa makyerɛ adiyifoɔ no,
na mama anisoadehunu adɔɔso,
na menam adiyifoɔ ano so mabubu mmɛ.
Gilead yɛ abusudeɛ anaa?
Wɔadane ahuhudeɛ ara;

wɔn afɔrebukyia no nso te sɛ
afuo mu nkofie so aboɔkuo.
(Na Yakob dwane kɔɔ Siria asase so,
na Israel som ɛyerɛ ho,
na ɛyerɛ nti ɔhwɛɛ nnwan.)
Na AWURADE nam odiyifoɔ so yii Israel firii Misraim bae,
na ɔnam odiyifoɔ so hwɛɛ wɔn.
Efraim yii abufuo sɛ,
enti ɔbɛma mogya a ɔdi ho so no abua n’atifi,
na n’ahohora nso, n’AWURADE bɛdane agu ne so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
